column1: # THE JOBS SLICE'S DIRECTION COLUMN, AS A SIDE TABLE: one line per still-GAP
# row of _audit/_census/jobs.md, its direction (R, W or R+W), and -- for every
# row with a read half -- the page address that half needs and what the
# SHIPPED read boundary says about it.
# WHY A SIDE TABLE AND NOT A CENSUS COLUMN. _audit/2026-09-21-the-jobs-direction.md
# section 8 argues the census should NOT grow a sixth column: section 2 of
# jobs.md already carries direction per ROW-RANGE with its cost and
# reversibility beside it, and a per-row copy inside the census would drift
# from it. This file is the per-row reading, kept OUTSIDE the census and
# checked against it on every run.
# Checked by scripts/check_jobs_directions.py, which exits 1 on: a still-GAP
# jobs row with no line or a line for a row that left GAP; a dir_phrase no
# longer written in the row's own capability cell; a dir_basis that section 2
# of jobs.md no longer bears out; an is_read_url, refusal or also_driven
# verdict the live boundary disagrees with; a source that no longer resolves;
# or any break in the vocabulary below. The read-address columns follow
# _audit/_census/read-addresses.tsv exactly, so one reader serves both.
# dir          R | W | R+W   (R+W: the row's own text names a read AND a write)
# dir_phrase   the words of the row's own capability cell that decide dir;
#              for R+W, the read word + the write word
# dir_basis    VERB             the phrase decides, and section 2's range
#                               cell agrees or names no single direction
#              VERB-OVER-RANGE  the phrase decides AGAINST a single-direction
#                               range cell in section 2 (recorded, not hidden)
#              COMPOUND         the row names both acts (R+W)
#              RESOLVED         the text alone did not settle it; the note
# class        ADMITTED | REFUSED | NO-ADDRESS | NEEDS-SESSION | UNDETERMINED
#              for a row with a read half; WRITE for a row with none
# refusal      the shipped refusal's kind, read off assert_read_url
# gate         ADMITTED rows only: READER | PRESS-PERMITTED | MEASURE |
# also_driven  <address>=><is_read_url> ; ...   each re-driven on every check
# EVERY VARIABLE SEGMENT IS A PLACEHOLDER -- placeholder-org, placeholder,
# 1234567890, 12345. The allowlist patterns accept a SHAPE, not a value, so no
# verdict depends on the value standing there.
